cover_headline: DHS Final Rule Permanently Ends Automatic Work Permit Extensions For Renewals
facts: The final rule makes permanent the end of the 540-day automatic extension for EAD renewals filed on or after October 30, 2025
H-4 spouses in category (c)(26) and adjustment-of-status applicants in (c)(9) are among those affected
Renewals filed before October 30, 2025 that qualified keep their automatic extension

end.headline: DHS Final Rule Permanently Ends Automatic Work Permit Extensions For Renewals
end.line: H-4 spouses and green card applicants must now get approval before their card expires.
